body:
Step C1 of the polish-pass mandate: audit Phase-3 systems for the "unit-tested but never composed in the live loop" bug class (same shape as the pass-the-ball bug fixed in b153678). Deliverable is a findings list + task-spec links for each fix.

Method: cross-reference each Phase-3 system's public API against actual call sites in MatchSimulationRunner, DotsMatchDirector, EventBridge, OverlayController. Anything that has tests + no call site is a confirmed integration hole.

Findings (so far this wake-up):

(1) MEMORY LAYER NOT INTEGRATED. Severity: P1 (same class as pass-the-ball). Components Ledger, MemoryEvent, MemoryEmissionRules.EmitForKeyEvents, PressFanReader, BreakthroughReader are all implemented in MatchSim/Memory/, have 42 passing tests, and are referenced in SPEC closure prose as "end-to-end Unity Mono load verified". But that verification was a synthetic execute_code injection at SPEC closure time — Ledger is never instantiated, MemoryEmissionRules.EmitForKeyEvents is never called, the readers are never consulted in live match play. Per ADR-0004 MatchSim correctly does NOT touch the ledger; the bridge lives outside; the natural owner is DotsMatchDirector (post-RunTicks, translates new KeyEvents into MemoryEvents, holds the readers for future UI surfacing). Fix scope: instantiate Ledger in DotsMatchDirector; call MemoryEmissionRules.EmitForKeyEvents after RunTicks with the new KeyEvents slice; instantiate PressFanReader + BreakthroughReader for future UI consumption; log debug counts as L2 evidence. Optional Phase-3 minimum: surface ONE press-fan callback in OverlayController on first Goal (Phase-3 cosmetic). Task-spec to follow as a separate cycle.

(2) SIGNATURES DO NOT FIRE IN NATURAL PLAY. Severity: P1 (downstream Slice-7 visuals depend on them). I ran 70 seconds of natural-play smoke fixture (with pass-the-ball b153678 in place, ball moving naturally): 1 Goal KeyEvent fired (HomeScore=1) but SignatureRecipes.Count=0. The 3 Phase-3 signatures (LowCutback / BlindSideNearPostRun / FirstTimeDiagonalSwitch) have spatial+role+velocity gates the smoke fixture's chaotic 22-player pressing never satisfies. Downstream impact: Slice-7 selection-rings, motion-lines, camera-rhythm-tier-Tension, and pressure-tint all depend on signature events; they never fire in natural play because the trigger conditions never compose. Fix scope: either (a) loosen Phase-3 signature trigger conditions to fire on the smoke fixture's actual geometry (risk: makes the canonical hash drift), or (b) author a NEW seed/fixture that has formation conditions known to satisfy at least one signature trigger. (b) is cleaner. Task-spec to follow as a separate cycle (C4).

(3) Other Phase-3 systems verified COMPOSED in the live loop: BallPhysics.Step, PlayerActuator.Step, PlayerActuator.HasPossession (via SignatureRules.IsCarrier), MatchRules.Step, SignatureRules.Step, BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick + new ChoosePassKick + ApplyTeamKickIfAny (b153678), MatchSimulationConfig (Seed.Derive Phase-3 unused but plumbed), IdentityPackets.Load (called by DotsMatchDirector.LoadPackets at Awake), CommentaryTemplates (called by OverlayController.MaybeTriggerOverlay on dispatched ViewerEvents — verified naturally firing in pass-the-ball L2 capture).

acceptance:
- This task-spec posts a findings list (NO code changes); follow-up cycles fix each finding.
- Each finding (1) and (2) get their own task-spec posted as a follow-up.
- Closure note in CHANGELOG records the audit + links to the follow-up cycles.

files_in_scope:
- This is an audit-only task. No files modified by THIS topic; findings drive subsequent cycles.

files_out_of_scope:
- Everything (audit-only).

max_tokens: 50000
max_wall_clock_seconds: 1800
max_turns: 8

implementing_agent: claude; reviewing_agent: codex.

depends_on: pass-the-ball (b153678), blueprint patch (8e2dc1b).

C1 audit complete (no code changes). 2 P1 integration holes confirmed: (1) Memory layer un-integrated (Ledger never instantiated; MemoryEmissionRules never called; SPEC closure prose 'end-to-end Unity Mono load verified' referred to synthetic execute_code injection); (2) Signatures don't fire in natural play (70s smoke fixture produced 1 Goal but 0 SignatureRecipes; Slice-7 visuals (selection rings, motion lines, camera-rhythm-Tension, pressure-tint) all depend on signature events and so also do not fire naturally). Both will get follow-up /duo-implement cycles. 14 other Phase-3 systems verified COMPOSED in the live loop. No Codex review needed for audit itself (no code); but Codex will review the 2 follow-up fixes.
